notes: Git: create-branch + merge (lazygit n/N/M), branches sorted current-first then by recency, a toggles stage/unstage-all. FileTree: new file/folder + drag-drop from Finder + double-click rename + live watcher (Zed-style). Editor: external-edit reload (skips dirty tabs), diff editor remount flicker fixed. Rundeck: live step updates, full log backlog for old runs, env picker reuses TopBar pill. AWS: per-view refresh chip, auth-expired auto-flips TopBar chip, fixed [object Object] errors, CloudWatch logs selectable during tailing. TopBar: version + update chips on the left, 12-hour clock, battery glyph. Terminal: Cmd+arrows / Cmd+Backspace / Opt+word-motion, drag-drop file paths into terminal, hidden terminals paused, white scrollbar hidden. Sessions: Alt+Shift+Tab cycles groups, env-aware state (~/.config/sikemux/state.dev.json for dev). Bundled app inherits user PATH (hermes/aws/rnd resolve). New: per-agent shield toggle for --dangerously-skip-permissions / --yolo / --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox.
